newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to raise excise tax on cigarettes, alcohol.
newsitem.headline: Poland to raise excise tax on cigarettes, alcohol.

text.p: Poland will raise the excise tax on vodka and cigarettes by nine and 10 percent respectively as of February 17, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
It said excise tax on wine and beer would rise by eight percent.
"The rises are as envisaged by the 1997 budget and are necessary to reach the planned budget revenues for this year," the Finance Ministry's press office said.
